title: usenet-ipfs v1: NNTP over IPFS — full implementation
description: Root epic for the usenet-ipfs v1 implementation. Two binaries (usenet-ipfs-transit and usenet-ipfs-reader) sharing usenet-ipfs-core. Articles stored as IPLD blocks in IPFS addressed by CID. Group state is a per-group Merkle-CRDT append-only log reconciled over libp2p gossipsub. Reader speaks RFC 3977 NNTP verbatim so slrn/tin/pan/gnus/Thunderbird work without modification. Standalone system; no Corundum integration in v1.
